newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria warns against further attacks on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Syria warns against further attacks on Iraq.

text.p: DAMASCUS, Sept 4 (reuter) - Syria on Wednesday blasted the U.S. missile raids on Iraq and warned Washington that further attacks could have unpredictable consequences.

"The Pentagon's announcement on the possibility of launching new operations (against Iraq) is rejected and denounced and might lead the region to possibilities open in all directions," the ruling party al-Baath newspaper said.

The United States launched missile attacks against air defence positions in southern Iraq on Tuesday and Wednesday to neutralise possible Iraqi resistance to Washington's decision to extend the southern air-exclusion zone.
An official Syrian spokesman said on Tuesday the U.S. bombing of Iraqi targets violated the U.N. charter and was "a threat to the unity of Iraq and its regional safety".
"The American attack on the Iraqi positions renews the chance to threaten the unity and sovereignty of Iraq on every single inch of its land," al-Baath said.
"It renews the chance to create a new reality that opens the door wide before (foreign) control over the region's wealth," it said.
Syria has been at odds for years with Iraqi President Saddam Hussein, but it says it rejects any action that threatens Iraq's unity.
